## Ambience (location or scene `ambience`)

- none: No ambience bed.
- city_traffic: A low traffic rumble with cars passing (streets).
- park_birds: A soft breeze and birds chirping (parks).
- rain: A steady patter of rain.
- wind: Gusts of wind (mountains, open places).
- crowd_murmur: Many voices far away (arenas, markets).
- cave_drip: A quiet room tone and echoing drips (caves, lairs).

## World commands for places and objects

| do | params (* required) | what it does |
|---|---|---|
| set_theme | theme*:theme | Switches the background theme (v1 clips; stories use scenes). |
| set_time | time*:dawn/day/dusk/night dur:0-10 | Changes the time of day, fading over `dur` seconds. |
| set_weather | weather*:clear/cloudy/rain/snow/wind/fog dur:0-10 | Changes the weather, fading over `dur` seconds. |
| spawn_prop | prop* x*:0-8000 y:0-2000 | Puts a prop on the floor for someone to pick up. |
| prop_break | owner*:id | Breaks the prop a character is holding. |
| spawn_object | kind* id x*:-2000-14000 y:0-2000 layer:back/mid/front state facing:1/-1 | Adds an object from the catalog to the scene. |
| remove_object | - | Removes the object named in the beat's `object` field. |
| set_object | state toX:-2000-14000 height:0-1500 vx:-3000-3000 vy:-3000-3000 speed:10-3000 exit:left/right | Changes an object (named in `object`): a state, or sends a ball, floater or vehicle moving. |
